perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

enhanced.name: Proximity Grenades
enhanced.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.description: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

enhanced.name: Shot Swap
enhanced.description: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at an additionally improved rate.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

enhanced.name: Genesis
enhanced.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield. Also increases weapon handling.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Threat Detector
enhanced.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

enhanced.name: Rimestealer
enhanced.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you an improved amount of Frost Armor.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

enhanced.name: Disruption Break
enhanced.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

enhanced.name: Thresh
enhanced.description: Defeating combatants with this weapon generates an improved small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

enhanced.name: Turnabout
enhanced.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

enhanced.name: Pugilist
enhanced.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch
enhanced.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
enhanced.description: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.
